ov: Small, fast predators with long, slender bodies and short legs, in the same genus as stoats, polecats and ferrets. In Britain “weasel” means the least weasel, the smallest carnivore of all.
rg: Europe, Asia and North America; the least weasel crossed to North America about 200,000 years ago.
df: Mainly small rodents such as voles, plus birds when rodents are scarce.

cf.tip: Stoats and weasels are close relatives in the same genus; the least weasel is the smaller of the two.

fx: It doesn’t dig its own den, but moves into the old burrow of a mole or rat.
